shared_elements: curvilinear carved motifs in low relief
stylized creature forms (bird-like heads / winged form)
justification: Both surfaces carry low-relief carved imagery including rounded/spiral elements and creature-like heads, but that is about as generic as a correspondence can be. A shows isolated, massive, highly schematic bird-headed forms carved on boulders with no organized scene, while B presents a strictly ordered rectangular field: a winged disc in a lunette, a register of standing figures facing each other with raised arms, and multiple horizontal lines of script below — a compositional scheme wholly absent from A.
